scope: Synthetic held-out-composition evaluation of the selected revision-gain policy; not R2, autonomous revision detection, production promotion, external validity or SNN superiority
task: Each address activates three sparse shared routes: left symbol, right symbol and interval. Seeded balanced binary signs are assigned independently to every feature value. The label is the majority sign of the three active features. Training and seen pre-revision evaluation use only the registered training split. Held-out evaluation uses only disjoint address compositions from the registered held-out split, while every individual feature value occurs in both splits. A supplied revision ID 2 arrives before held-out post-revision prediction and flips all feature signs. The candidate uses residual updates at rate 0.40 for exactly 864 successful decisions, capped to absolute delta 0.50, then returns to signed constant updates at rate 0.15. Labels are revealed only after prediction. The atomic arm uses one address-specific route and cannot share state across unseen compositions. One frozen execution; no post-result tuning or retry.
failure_policy: Retain negative evidence and stop this shared-route transfer line if any adoption or resource gate fails. A pass authorizes only source-backed revision evaluation; it is not R2 or production evidence.
